text:
mia_cs: Heads-up — NovaLabs weekly check. I pulled the dashboard and saw a big token + throughput uptick this week vs last. Can someone post a short QoW and QoQ readout (tokens, throughput/rps, p95 latency, 5xx rate, spend) and any obvious root causes?

josh_csm: Quick numbers from our analytics view (rolled up to account):
```
tokens/day (this week): 1.18M  (WoW +47%, QoQ +21%)
avg rps (24h): 22.5  (peak 78)
p95 latency: 340ms  (WoW +55ms, QoQ +80ms)
5xx error rate: 0.72%  (WoW +0.45ppt)
est. monthly spend burn: $13.2k  (last month $9.0k)
```
josh_csm: Notes: spike started ~3 days ago, primarily on /v1/generate requests (short prompts, high qps). Embeddings volume steady.

liam_eng: Saw the same in infra traces. Two possible contributors:
- NovaLabs increased concurrency on their client side ~2x (we see more short-lived connections), leading to smaller batch sizes but more scheduling overhead.
- We rolled model-variant "vicuna-13b-q4f16" -> "vicuna-13b-q5f16" for them last week (quantization tweak) — kernel selection changes cause some p95 regressions for short sequences.

ops-bot: :warning: Alert: throughput anomaly for org=novalabs detected. Sustained token/sec +110% for 72h, error rate above baseline. Incident ID: IN-2026-1125-novalabs

josh_csm: Customer comment (from support thread):
"We're seeing more 502s during peak inference, and latency spikes hitting our SLAs. This started after the last model swap. Can you revert?" — Ana (Nova Labs).

liam_eng: Revert would be fastest mitigation. I can push a rollback to the previous quant profile and reduce the batching window for short calls. Proposed immediate actions:
- rollback quant profile to v3.2.1 for novalabs (fast rollback)
- set batching window to 10ms for their shard (reduces head-of-line)
- scale one extra GPU pool for their dedicated nodes for 24h (buy us headroom)

katie_enablement: I'll schedule a 30m sync with Ana to walk through client-side concurrency and recommended backoff/retry guidance. Also want to capture if they changed client SDK version.

mia_cs: Risk assessment: Renewal in 6 weeks. If we don't stabilize latency and reduce 5xxs, this becomes a churn risk. Please log customer impact in the account ticket and mark P1 if rollback doesn't restore p95 under 350ms within 2 hours.

liam_eng: On it. I'll start the rollback and post status here.

ops-bot: Action queued: rollback quant profile -> v3.2.1. Job ID: job-8892. ETA ~7m.

liam_eng: Patch applied, batching window set to 10ms, scaled extra gpu pool. Monitoring for 30m.

josh_csm: Post-change metrics (10m after change):
```
tokens/day (projected): 1.05M  (WoW +28%)
avg rps (10m sample): 19.1
p95 latency (10m): 290ms  (improved ~50ms)
5xx rate (10m): 0.21%  (down from 0.72%)
est. monthly spend (projected): $12.6k
```

ana_customer: @josh_csm thanks — latency looks much better on our side, 502s dropped. We'll confirm after today's peak.

mia_cs: Great. Owners and next steps:
- Owner: josh_csm (customer comms, renewal risk tracker)
- Eng owner: liam_eng (follow-up perf tuning + postmortem)
- Enablement: katie_enablement (client SDK/concierge session)
- Timeline: confirm stability over 48h, then schedule a short postmortem with NovaLabs.

josh_csm: Logged in CRM and created internal ticket CS-7624. Adding notes: "rollback applied, monitor 48h, risk downgraded to medium if stable."

liam_eng: I'll run a quick experiment tomorrow to test kernel selection fallback for short prompts and file a runtime patch if needed. Command used for rollback: `redwood rollout revert --target novalabs --to v3.2.1`

katie_enablement: Meeting set for tomorrow 10:00 PST with Ana. Agenda: client concurrency, retry/backoff, SDK version. I'll add a short runbook for customers experiencing similar regressions.

mia_cs: Thanks team. Please update this thread with any regression or re-escalation. :white_check_mark:
